description: Bounded source-level evidence attribution. Module membership and corpus coverage must be derived from the canonical compatibility report, not from this mapping.
execution_status: This file attributes test behavior; passing execution evidence is supplied separately by reference-layout/coverage_test_results.xml and validated during figure generation.
limits: Non-shared groups exercise the named module's callable or output behavior, not its complete setting space or CellProfiler parity. Shared-only groups credit only the named implementation behavior. Parametrized nodeids select all cases of that function.

groups.behavior: Reconstructs measurement-input contracts and executes statistics on image/object measurement tables; checks Zfactor, Vfactor, OneTailedZfactor and EC50 feature names and experiment scope, not numerical accuracy of every statistic.
Reconstructs repeated-group measurement contracts and executes ANY/ALL flag combinations with exact emitted flag rows.
Executes base and EMD image-overlap variants and checks conditional input/output contracts and EMD schema presence; does not assert overlap metric numerical parity.

Converts two binary objects into nominal labels and typed statistics. Executes dead-worm identification on an empty image with typed rows and zero declared objects; does not validate real-worm detection accuracy.
Compares disk-radius-three stack morphology exactly against per-plane skimage references; selected parametrization includes these two module callables.
Executes the object-dilation boundary and checks rejection of a volumetric footprint on two-dimensional labels; not valid-dilation numerical evidence.
Executes display callables against declared image/object measurement tables; checks point counts, histogram counts, well identities and per-well object means. Does not verify native plot painting.

Executes supplied-label editing with retained sparse object IDs 2 and 5 and checks rejection of unsupported layered overlap. Does not exercise interactive annotation. The helper IdentifyObjectsManually is non-executable and is not credited as a processing module.
Executes NUMBA-backed convex-hull filling and compares the retained object's mask against the morphology owner reference.
Executes the NUMBA convex-hull Morph operation and compares binary pixels against the morphology owner reference; other Morph operations are not covered by this node.
Executes per-parent merging with convex-hull output and checks one resulting object and exact hull pixels; not all splitting or merging modes.
Executes planar skeletonization, compares pixels with skimage skeletonize and checks the PURE_2D processing contract.
Executes object-center shrinking and checks measurement row count, nominal label payload and one retained pixel per object.
Executes one-impulse maxima detection with exact count/settings rows and default zero-angle rotation with unchanged pixels and a typed rotation row. Does not cover nonzero rotations.

Executes Gaussian filtering through the function-contract executor for one and three calibrated sites; compares anisotropic Gaussian pixels and verifies independent sites, metadata, mask and original input preservation.
Executes all eight RGB enable masks, checking grayscale values, channel ordering, metadata and the no-output case.
Executes average, maximum, minimum, sum, variance and mask projections and compares values against NumPy references.
Executes matching against an actual template file and checks shape, float32 dtype and the expected correlation maximum.
Executes a straight skeleton measurement, retaining input pixels and emitting typed rows with zero branches and two endpoints.
Executes seeded object-skeleton analysis and checks retained branchpoint pixels and measurement rows against the same analysis owner; consistency evidence, not an independent numerical reference.
Executes medial-axis extraction and checks float32 binary output, nonempty support and fewer foreground pixels than the solid input; not exact pixel parity.
Executes callable output composition with the Fiji request send method monkeypatched; checks declared output names, order and values. Does not execute Fiji, its server or a real macro.
Executes three stain rows including a custom stain; checks one float32 image per row, output shapes, removed channel-axis metadata and the FLEXIBLE processing contract; not stain-separation accuracy.

Credits only shared image-payload pixel replacement through with_image_payload_data: calibrated Gaussian execution checks mask, metadata and input preservation. Reducenoise uses this owner, but this node does not execute Reducenoise or validate non-local-means denoising.

Credits only shared nominal-label materialization through object_label_dense_array: AreaOccupied consumes a nominal payload and checks area four, total area sixteen and unchanged image. MeasureObjectOverlap uses the same owner; overlap metrics and EMD are not exercised by this node.
